crossRefs.note: This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh…

translations.web: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.
translations.bsb: And a similar plague will strike the horses and mules, camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps.
translations.kjv: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
translations.asv: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in those camps, as that plague.
